title: A held CR folder: wait it out on Windows, then refuse with the cause
summary: Spec v2, decisions board-lock-Q1..Q4 (all A), batch-30: on Windows every CR folder move (FolderStore.move) waits up to 10 s for a held folder, then refuses with nothing moved and names the likely holders; startup-core.md extends the no-cd-into-a-CR-folder rule to every role.
